title: the webb blog
subtitle: Welcome to Paul Anthony Webb’s corner of the ’Net where he’ll regale you with whatever he finds interesting.

posts.title: Self-hosting Mastodon and Bluesky
posts.description: Remember re/thinking Twitter handles for your various projects? It’s 2026, I’m not doing all that for a shit platform. I will spend hours wrangling social I control though.

posts.title: Beginning of the Ende
posts.description: The trend of VC-backed tooling ending in abandonment rears its ugly head again. But hey, people gotta eat, right? The community will pick up the slack and steward the projects, right?

posts.title: Should developers design?
posts.description: Design, the practice deemed worthless two decades ago via the tired meme “should designers code?” is now the only way to prove your humanity (and worth?) in the age of slop.
